title: 08-C E2E receipt (REQ-08C-01, Issue #2014)
description: One line per E2E measurement. This receipt is the ONLY input to the 08-D support table (docs/support-matrix.md); a combination without a passed receipt is not supported, and every not_run/blocked combination must appear here unhidden.

ac.description: The acceptance criterion this receipt measures, e.g. AC-08C-3.

os.description: uname -s or the runner OS label (P12: macOS only in RC1).

arch.description: uname -m or the runner arch label.

host.description: The host under test; none for T1 fixture runs.

host_exact_version.description: The exact host binary version the run used (claude --version / codex --version output).

skill_digest.description: sha256 of the projected skills/moai/SKILL.md the run loaded.

moai_cli_sha.description: sha256 of the moai-cli binary involved; null when none exists (clean clone).

ran_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, second precision, measured when the run finished.

detail.description: Path to the raw output the verdict was read from. Credential VALUES never appear in a receipt or its detail files.
